sample_unit: documents/records (MIMIC-III 2.1M documents, i2b2 858K records, proprietary hospital dataset 1.5M records)

links.outcome: Membership inference risk reduction with differential privacy and privacy auditing in clinical LLM
links.effect: Mitigated membership inference risk by 65.9% versus state-of-the-art privacy-preserving LLMs; utility-privacy trade-off improved 15.8% at ε=0.1, δ=10⁻⁶.
links.quote: By improving the utility–privacy trade-off by 15.8%, mitigating membership inference risk by 65.9%, and reducing computational overhead by 23.4%, the framework establishes a more secure, efficient, and trustworthy foundation for clinical AI deployment.

unlisted_practices: Differentially private training (DP-SGD) of clinical LLMs with adaptive noise calibration
Hierarchical privacy budget allocation by medical data category using Renyi DP accounting

screen.reason: The study develops and empirically evaluates a differential privacy framework (PrivLLM-Guard) with adaptive noise calibration, hierarchical budgeting, and real-time auditing guardrails for clinical LLM documentation and summarization on benchmark datasets.

primary.practice: differential privacy and real-time privacy auditing
